market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1-3 months. RBA rate hike risk, oil-driven inflation, and housing stress dominate. Gold and coal miners outperform; banks and property lag. Expect ^AXJO volatility 3-5% weekly. Bathla resolution is a key near-term catalyst.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Productivity 'bad to worse' and per capita recession risk cap upside. However, commodity cycle (gold, coal, copper) and large-cap dividends provide floor. Housing correction may be 10-15% but unlikely systemic if RBA pauses. Recovery contingent on productivity inflection and global demand.
